label: TP
reason: User input directly reaches the XSS sink via concatenation into HTML output without escaping. Although HtmlUtils.htmlEscape() is called on param, it is stored in variable baz which remains unescaped. The sink uses baz (the unescaped version), allowing script tags to be injected.

evidence.note: baz holds unescaped param and is used in XSS sink while param is escaped separately
